package org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner;

import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Canonical form for an owner address, applied whenever an owner is created. Trims and collapses
 * runs of whitespace to a single space, upper-cases, and expands common abbreviations
 * ({@code ST} → {@code STREET}, {@code RD} → {@code ROAD},
 * {@code AVE} → {@code AVENUE}) as whole words. A {@code null} or blank value
 * normalizes to the empty string. The result is idempotent, so an already-normalized address is
 * returned unchanged. This is the single source of truth every address comparison uses.
 */
public final class AddressNormalizer {

    private static final Map<String, String> ABBREVIATIONS = Map.of(
            "ST", "STREET",
            "RD", "ROAD",
            "AVE", "AVENUE");

    private AddressNormalizer() {
    }

    /** Normalize an address to its canonical stored/returned form. */
    public static String normalize(String value) {
        if (value == null) {
            return "";
        }
        String collapsed = value.trim().replaceAll("\\s+", " ").toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
        if (collapsed.isEmpty()) {
            return "";
        }
        String[] tokens = collapsed.split(" ");
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(collapsed.length());
        for (int i = 0; i < tokens.length; i++) {
            if (i > 0) {
                sb.append(' ');
            }
            sb.append(ABBREVIATIONS.getOrDefault(tokens[i], tokens[i]));
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }
}

package org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.common;

import java.util.Map;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

/**
 * Derives an owner's locality (region). The postcode is preferred: when it falls within a known
 * region's inclusive range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099) that region is returned.
 * Only when the postcode is absent or in no known range does the fixed city-to-region table apply.
 * Anything the postcode and city both fail to resolve derives the locality {@code "UNKNOWN"}.
 */
public final class Localities {

    /** City -> canonical region. */
    private static final Map<String, String> CITY_REGION = Map.of(
            "Sydney", "NSW",
            "Melbourne", "VIC",
            "Brisbane", "QLD");

    /** Region -> inclusive 4-digit postcode range {low, high}. */
    private static final Map<String, int[]> REGION_POSTCODES = Map.of(
            "NSW", new int[] {2000, 2099},
            "VIC", new int[] {3000, 3099},
            "QLD", new int[] {4000, 4099});

    /** Region -> IANA timezone name. */
    private static final Map<String, String> REGION_TIMEZONE = Map.of(
            "NSW", "Australia/Sydney",
            "VIC", "Australia/Melbourne",
            "QLD", "Australia/Brisbane");

    private static final Pattern FOUR_DIGITS = Pattern.compile("^[0-9]{4}$");

    /** Locality returned for any city not in the table. */
    public static final String UNKNOWN = "UNKNOWN";

    private Localities() {
    }

    /**
     * @param city the owner's city (may be {@code null}).
     * @return the canonical region for {@code city}, or {@code "UNKNOWN"} when it is not
     *         in the table.
     */
    public static String region(String city) {
        return CITY_REGION.getOrDefault(city, UNKNOWN);
    }

    /**
     * Derives the locality preferring the postcode over the city.
     *
     * @param postcode the owner's postcode (may be {@code null} or blank).
     * @param city     the owner's city (may be {@code null}).
     * @return the region for {@code postcode} when it falls in a known range; otherwise the
     *         city-derived region, or {@code "UNKNOWN"} when neither resolves.
     */
    public static String region(String postcode, String city) {
        String byPostcode = regionForPostcode(postcode);
        return byPostcode != null ? byPostcode : region(city);
    }

    /**
     * Derives the IANA timezone name for an owner, from the region derived by
     * {@link #region(String, String)} via the fixed region-to-timezone table
     * (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane).
     *
     * @param postcode the owner's postcode (may be {@code null} or blank).
     * @param city     the owner's city (may be {@code null}).
     * @return the IANA timezone name, or {@code null} when the region is not in the table.
     */
    public static String timezone(String postcode, String city) {
        return REGION_TIMEZONE.get(region(postcode, city));
    }

    /**
     * @return the region whose inclusive range contains {@code postcode}, or {@code null} when the
     *         postcode is absent, malformed, or in no known range.
     */
    private static String regionForPostcode(String postcode) {
        if (postcode == null || postcode.isBlank() || !FOUR_DIGITS.matcher(postcode).matches()) {
            return null;
        }
        int value = Integer.parseInt(postcode);
        for (Map.Entry<String, int[]> entry : REGION_POSTCODES.entrySet()) {
            int[] range = entry.getValue();
            if (value >= range[0] && value <= range[1]) {
                return entry.getKey();
            }
        }
        return null;
    }
}

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true

      properties:
        id:

          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name

      type: object
      properties:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat input for backward
            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is preferred and
            'address' is returned as the composed, normalized string (addressLine1, plus a single
            space and addressLine2 when addressLine2 is present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Preferred over the flat
            'address' when present; normalized the same way (trimmed, whitespace collapsed,
            upper-cased, common abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '10 King St'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address. When present it is
            normalized and appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be four digits and,
            for a city with a known region (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), fall
            within that region's range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city
            with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on
            create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2013-01-01'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional; when present it
            is used to derive the read-only 'ageBand' relative to the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-05-14'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Create-only opt-in acknowledging that this owner deliberately shares a
            household (same last name and postcode) with an existing owner. The
            householdId is computed regardless; this flag only bypasses the household
            duplicate block, so a matching owner is created as a declared household
            member instead of being rejected with 409 (and is not flagged a possible
            duplicate). The full-identity duplicate check still applies.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country code, a space,
                then the national digits grouped in threes. The raw 'telephone' stays E.164.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION is the
                region derived from the postcode (falling back to the city-to-region table)
                and HASH8 is the first eight upper-cased hex characters of SHA-256 over the
                normalized telephone concatenated with the lastName. Assigned at creation;
                there is no per-city sequence number.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the
                customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A deterministic household identifier: the first 12 hex characters of
                SHA-256 over '<normalizedLastName>|<postcode>'. Computed for every owner,
                so any two owners with the same last name and postcode automatically
                carry the same value and belong to the same household.
              type: string
              example: '1a2b3c4d5e6f'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formatted
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email>|<householdId>' where email is the stored
                lower-cased email (empty when absent) and householdId is the household id
                (empty when absent). Two owners are considered duplicates only when their
                whole identityKey matches; a create whose key equals an existing owner's is
                rejected with 409.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||1a2b3c4d5e6f'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was created,
                shared the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY
                is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points. Starts at 0, plus 2 when an email is present,
                plus 1 when namesakeCount is 0, plus 2 for a household of 3 or more members,
                plus 3 for tenure of more than 365 days between the registration date and
                today. Because a newly created owner has zero tenure, a new owner tops out
                at 5 points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, from 1 to 4, mapped from membershipPoints:
                1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more. Because a
                newly created owner has zero tenure, a new owner tops out at 5 points and
                therefore never exceeds level 3.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's region, derived from city using the fixed city-to-region
                table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD). 'UNKNOWN' when the
                city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived from the locality/region using the
                fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived at read time:
                'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from birthDate relative to the registrationDate:
                'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, 'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Present
                only when a birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 other owners share this owner's registration
                date (i.e. more than 80 owners had already been created that day),
                otherwise false. Flags a suspiciously high volume of same-day signups.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, shares an existing
                owner's lastName and postcode while having a different telephone;
                otherwise false. A soft-match flag raised at creation time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matches on lastName and
                postcode (with a different telephone). Present only when
                'possibleDuplicate' is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
